recipes.label: Invoking The Pride
recipes.startdescription: Whenever the principle of The Pride is invoked, I may experience an increase in Vitality.
recipes.description: The rhythm of my heart pounds in time with the shared beat of humanity.

recipes.label: Inner Dialogue Commenced
recipes.startdescription: As I engage in Inner Dialogue, my Vitality may rise.
recipes.description: A serene calm blankets my mind, silence becomes a comforting companion.

recipes.label: Enlensing the Absurd
recipes.startdescription: As I engage in the act of Enlensing, my Vitality may be restored.
recipes.description: I perceive life from a renewed perspective, hidden truths unveil their beauty.

recipes.label: Ritual of Remembering
recipes.startdescription: When I Remember, I may gain additional scraps of knowledge.
recipes.description: Long-lost memories emerge from the fog of forgotten past, now clear as crystal.

recipes.label: Path of Counter-Spiralling
recipes.startdescription: There is knowledge to be gained from the act of Counter-Spiralling.
recipes.description: I venture beyond the spiral's pull, reveling in the spectrum of experience.

recipes.label: The Flow's Embrace
recipes.startdescription: Engaging with the Flow may shed light on previously hidden insights.
recipes.description: I traverse life's currents, my resilience rendering me invincible against adversity.

recipes.label: Cultivation of Antibodies
recipes.startdescription: In creating Antibodies, I may gain hidden insights.
recipes.description: I liberate myself from external chains, becoming immune to the foreign within.

recipes.label: Ego's Unbinding
recipes.startdescription: In the process of Ego Loosening, there is wisdom to be unearthed.
recipes.description: I reshape my identity like malleable metal, embracing change and fostering growth.

recipes.label: The Larping Game
recipes.startdescription: The act of Larping may bring forth unforeseen revelations.
recipes.description: I flit between personas, tasting myriad perspectives, unshackled from my singular viewpoint.

recipes.label: Invisible Hand Revealed
recipes.startdescription: Grasping the mechanism of the Invisible Hand may induce an inexplicable restlessness.
recipes.description: The shroud lifts, revealing the machinations of capital's cold, calculating control.

recipes.label: The Dark, the Light
recipes.startdescription: Moth finds the light in the dark, and so do I.
recipes.description: What could I be if I could be not this?

recipes.label: Night Terrors
recipes.startdescription: I wake in the night. My palms, my face, are beaded with sweat.
recipes.description: Slowly, my clenched fists relax. I'll slide back into sleep. But something will remain, like spiderwebs in the corner of the room.

recipes.label: Night Terrors
recipes.comments: Only triggers if there's already Dread in whatever called this.

recipes.label: New Colours
recipes.startdescription: I have begun to notice colours in the world for which I have no name.
recipes.description: I am seeing things I shouldn't. I know this is dangerous. But it's difficult not to long for it.

recipes.label: The Public Gaze
recipes.startdescription: I've used a follower who's too well-known. The Suppression Bureau may hear of it.

recipes.label: The Creeping Colour
recipes.startdescription: My passions are poisoned. Each pang of emotion brings an answering pang of savage grey.

recipes.label: Relentless Light
recipes.startdescription: A candle, when burned, brings light. When my thoughts ignite, what then?

recipes.label: The Hospitality of Agony
recipes.startdescription: I have invited an old friend to lair in my muscles for one more day.

recipes.label: The Benefits of Privacy
recipes.startdescription: We've taken care to locate our headquarters somewhere out of the way...
recipes.description: ...perhaps it will be harder for the Suppression Bureau to follow leads to our door. It may also be harder to sustain a reputation.
